reviews.t: This is the wig for you! Get ready for compliments.
reviews.x: This is the wig for you!!! When I tell you it looks good af!!!! I'm trying out the FFCream color and will be purchasing another one later. I'm always hesitant about trying out colors. My natural hair color is a #2, but I wanted to try something different. It's not too shiny. It's just right!!! The curls are beautiful. I received so many compliments. The only thing I did was watch several YouTube videos of people doing reviews on this(type in Freetress Valentino). It's quite popular on YouTube. C
I ordered this wig for a friends wedding and it was amazing. I love wigs so I rely on quality. This wig is a game changer you will not be disappointed.

This wig is in the cream color, I believe. It’s soft, haven’t had issues with shedding, and you really don’t have to brush it like that. It’s an easy throw-on and go, or you could do slight customizations to make it a little more 😻. I did nothing to it in these pictures besides swoop the short hairs in the front a little. It was worth the money for sure.

This wig gave me sooo much life. Look no further this is the wig you need! It’s soft, the curls are beautiful, and the length is perfect for me. The lace is cut already all I did was add a little concealer to the part.
I love love this unit. Saw this unit on someone on Facebook and I just had to have it. It's so beautiful and the colors are so perfect. can't wait to order another
Such a pretty pretty wig, I always get compliments! Tangles and mats badly at the nape- so buy more than one so you switch between more than one

reviews.t: Love this wig and the parting space!
reviews.x: This wig is perfect. No tangles. The color is perfect. The curl pattern is perfect. This will for now on be my go to wig. I usually go for Fretress Danity, but Valentino is the “it” for me Now!!  In color FFcream.
Ladies this wig is cute... It is so cute.. Not a everyday wig.. It looks sheek.. Yes tangles does occur.. Synthetic... I am 😊 with choice.

This hair gave me life!!!!   I ordered it for my birthday and right out of the box it was extremely soft & the curls were  bi beautiful. The colors even more beautiful in natural sunlight.  That being said, it does tangles a lot, I believe I got 3 weeks weight  of it. I  brushed it when need be , and never slept with it on or anything extra if that nature.  I’m not a color kind of person but wanted to try something new and I’m happy I did. M will be ordering again.  *****It’s cheap so you get wh
So in love with this wig and the color the hair is so soft and the part looks so natural I’m buying more! I got so many compliments.

I purchased the cream. It’s a blend of colors like dark brown, chestnut and honey blonde. It’s not a light blond. The texture was nice and easy to comb. It did tangle after several used but using the wide tooth comb and flat iron bounced it back. It has the built on cap with pins. The part made it look just as if it was my own hair. Buy it.. you will love it

reviews.t: Great wig.......FF Cream color looks salon worthy.
reviews.x: My pictures are after wearing the unit for a couple of months (not everyday, maybe 10 times) and a wash. The unit was perfect upon opening the package. I just wanted to show what it looks like after you have had the unit for some time.....I did trim off the ends and used fabric softener as a rinse post wash as well as a curing iron.....

Love the color & curls!! This is straight out of the box, I did have on a beige stocking cap, and added some concealer to the parting space, but besides that, it served its purpose...I wear it for a few hours and snatch it off lol, and it’s still holding up good

At first I was so happy to find this wig on Amazon after seeing reviews on YouTube. This wig arrived worn it reeked of perfume and the inside smelled like unwashed hair . It even had the nerve to come with a “seal” I’m utterly disgusted.

Love love love her I have about 5 will be ordering more because they do get a bit Tangled after a while. But washing them and conditioning them also spraying them with oil and brushing them very well helps keep them looking good

reviews.t: This is my go to wig!
reviews.x: I’ve been buying this wig for over a year at another store online but when I saw that Amazon has it I immediately bought from Amazon. This is colorful in a classy way. It’s not to long. I wear it to the side and sometimes I dip it in hot water to get some of the curling’s out. It does start to tangle in the back after two or three weeks…it’s synthetic hair. To take the shine out I use wig shampoo. Anyway the golden, auburn and honey blonde Ombré colors make this wig special. I have several of th

reviews.t: Makes me look like a Diva times 10!!!
reviews.x: I've been buying this exact lace weave and color for 3 years over and over because it looks sooooo goood on me, this style just suits my face!! I get lots of compliments and I have people convinced it's my real hair even when I tell them it's a weave. I buy different style weaves in between wearing a new one of this style from the one I would have taken off, but I always go back to Valentino!!!  I"ve bought this in different colors as well but the FFCREAM just looks best on me. Price speaks for

reviews.t: I received so many compliments on this wig!
reviews.x: I don’t know too much about wigs. I appreciate the people who left reviews and pictures. That helped me decide to purchase it. There is no lace to cut. It has combs in the front and back. You can also tighten it in the back. It does tangle but nothing a brush can’t handle. I’ve worn it twice so far and was happy each time. I’d definitely purchase it again.

Love this unit! I have purchased just about every color. It is big head friendly and had a light yaki texture. The length is appropriate for work and sits a little past the shoulders ( I am 5ft 9). The only con I have is that the flyaways can make you crazy but you can tame them with wax stick or hairspray. Overall: Great value for $ and looks great!

reviews.t: Cheap looking wig with awful front
reviews.x: Wore this wig twice but with a headbead because the front is so fake looking. Definitely NOT lace front. Hair quality is poor, gets tangled and frizzes, even when using anti tangle products for synthetic hair. The only reason I gave it 2 stars is because the colors are pretty but I cannot wear this thing in public.

Love the look! Meant to be worn as a buss down but I twisted it to the side. Ear tads aren’t unbearable on the sides. Semi big head friendly! Some tangling towards the nape as expected but no shedding.
Color was great! The quality of the hair was poor. The wig was very frizzy, brassy-like, sheds and tangles alot throughout the day.
Love, love, love this unit! This is the FFCream color!

Update: It has been shedding a lot, I've never had shedding like this before. Just put it on this morning and when I lightly rand my fingers down through it, with 0 resistance, a handful of hair came out.  I was so in love with this wig, I've bought it about 4 times and it usually lasts 3-4 months before it's completey dried out and not taking any softener. reviews.t: Wanted to like the wig but it was a miss for me.
reviews.x: Just got this wig in Color FFcream and as much as I wanted to like this wig it did nothing for me, the curls were just blah noticed frizz when I tried it on and unfortunately I can’t send it back because I tried it on so I’m stuck with this wig I’ll try to revamp it for a Halloween look. The seller was great however shipment came on time that’s was a plus.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wig's softness and beautiful curls.
Many customers say the wig draws compliments and looks natural or salon-worthy.
Tangling is a common complaint, though some note it can be managed with brushing, washing, or conditioning.
The FF Cream color is widely loved and described as flattering and natural-looking.
Several reviewers plan to buy more or repurchase the wig.
